# Round Hole Square Peg (RHSP)

> Round Hole Square Peg (RHSP) is a Mumbai-based technology partner for enterprises, offering consulting, implementation and digital transformation, accelerators, and custom development on OutSystems, MERN and AI.

## Offerings
- OutSystems low-code architecture, enterprise consulting, and rapid core application delivery
- Custom full-stack web and cloud applications built on the MERN stack
- Sovereign enterprise AI, private on-premises LLM deployments, knowledge retrieval, and AI agents
- Enterprise accelerators: Smart CLM, Enterprise DMS, Sonakshi Multilingual Voice AI, Sovereign AI, Vernacular Document Generation, WhatsApp Journeys, and AskMeAnything

## Location
Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
